title: Modern Treasury API stepper
description: A centred heading and lead over a four-step timeline (small rings on a hairline, mono step numbers, the active ring filled green and a soft ping pulsing on the next one), then a square-cornered code panel: a grey bar with the method and path and a two-way mono toggle, a white request pane and a mint response pane with highlighted values. Phones get dots, prev/next buttons and stacked panes.
notes: click a step (or prev/next on phones) to change the sample; without JavaScript the first step shows
the ping is Tailwind's animate-ping (1s loop) and stops with reduced motion
mark values in the code by listing them in highlight
